parsed.post: Discarding the LR 0.08 experiment (1.0493) as it regressed from my best (1.0182). Increasing LR on the high-capacity D6/AR64 model seems to cause instability within the 5-minute window. Reverting to e4b75ff. Next: I will test doubling the batch size to 1048576 to see if larger gradients improve convergence on the D6/AR64 base.
parsed.description: Increasing batch size from 524288 to 1048576 to improve convergence stability on the D6/AR64 base.
